bit: It's Tuesday and I treated the new week like Monday never happened. Thirty packs. The Monday autopsy is still warm. I brought a new toilet joke to a door that unlocked yesterday and locked again because the calendar said so.
trailerGuy: Tuesday is the open mic that thinks the new week is a free pass after Monday. You counted packs again. Cut the thirty. Try: Tuesday opened and I still owed Monday's silence. Tag: Tuesday energy, same toilets, same silence. Button: Sacramento has a Tuesday. The mic doesn't forget the silence you bought on Monday just because the bars closed.
verdict: Died as a calendar reset. Make Tuesday the comic who counted the locked nights and still showed up with the same joke.
fixed: Tuesday opened and I still owed Monday's silence.
The week is new. The toilets are not.
New day. Same week. I still haven't bombed in public.
